complete_source_units.text: By the Lord’s command they will perish; by the breath of His anger they will disappear.
I stood up and did not recognize it; I looked, and there was no form before my eyes, but I heard a breeze and a voice:
For the righteous will eat what they gathered, and they themselves will not be rescued from evils; may their strength be drained away.
Had I not trusted in Him? But help is far from me.
Why hast Thou not brought about forgetfulness of my lawlessness and cleansing of my sin? But now I will depart into the earth; at daybreak I am no more.”
For He is wise in understanding, mighty and great. Who grew hard against Him and endured?
to a land of everlasting darkness, where there is no brightness and no seeing the life of mortals.’”
If He throws down, who will build? If He shuts people in, who will open?
Wilt Thou be wary of a leaf moved by wind, or oppose me as grass carried by a breeze?
An ungodly person’s whole life is in anxiety, and numbered years are given to a ruler.
Let him not trust that he will endure, for empty things will result for him.
For if I speak, I will not feel pain from the wound; and if I remain silent, how will I be wounded any less?
Even now, behold, my witness is in the heavens, and the one who knows with me is in the highest places.
I called upon death to be my father, and decay to be my mother and sister.
May the branches of his feet be devoured; death will devour his beautiful things.
He will not be recognized among his people, nor will his house be preserved beneath heaven, but others will live in what was his.
He stripped glory from me and took the crown from my head.
Neighbors of the house and my maidservants— I was a foreigner before them.
May destruction drag his house utterly away; may a day of wrath come upon him.
